films.title: METER DOWN
films.subtitle: Teaser (2:55)
films.tagline: Gurgaon ka ek auto. Meter rupaye nahi, saal ginta hai.
films.synopsis: A Hinglish comedy drawn entirely in code. Bablu drives the one auto in Gurgaon whose meter counts years instead of rupees. Priya is over-prepared for a 9:30 interview; Dev is applying because his mother forwarded the link; Tommy the street dog is already there. One pull of the lever and they are at the same corner in 1997, then 2047, with the fare stuck at Rs 137.50 until someone pays exact change. Three eras, three palettes, the same dog.
films.style: Sci-Fi Sitcom Toon (every frame drawn in code; voices by Kokoro TTS)
credits: Written, drawn, voiced, scored and cut in code by Claude for Anchit Tandon
Score and sound effects: synthesized in numpy
No real person's likeness appears in this film

films.title: A Boat Made of Paper
films.subtitle: The full voyage
films.tagline: One paper boat. Seven days. 140 kilometres of water that was never meant to be crossed.
films.synopsis: A child folds a boat from a page of a half-finished watercolour and sets it down in a monsoon gutter. The boat is the only thing on the page nobody painted, so the water cannot soak it the way it soaks everything else. Across eight chapters it drifts through a canal, a night of lamps, a crow's detour, the rains, a still lake, a city of lit windows and, finally, the sea. A quiet film about what survives by staying unfinished.
films.style: Watercolor Brush (every frame drawn in code)
credits: Written, drawn and directed in code by Claude for Anchit Tandon
Score: sampled piano (Salamander Grand Piano, CC BY 3.0) and coded strings

in_production.title: EK HI GAADI HAI
in_production.tagline: Ek beta, ek jhooth, ek hi gaadi.
in_production.synopsis: A Hinglish comedy-drama. Arjun has told his girlfriend's rich family that his father runs a transport business. His father, Ram Prasad, drives one auto-rickshaw, and her family is coming over at seven. I am making it with photoreal AI-generated actors (no real person is cloned), generated shot by shot on my own laptop with free, open tools, then cut to a coded edit with voices, score and subtitles.
in_production.style: Photoreal AI live action (every face generated)
plan: Story and full script: done (11 scenes, 169 lines)
Casting and the scene 1 first look: done
All 11 scenes generated shot by shot on a laptop, a few each night
Final voices, lip-sync, edit, music and subtitles, then the full film goes live on this page
